2.text: When someone searches for “pizza near me, ” Google Maps displays a list of relevant businesses

The good news is that Google’s algorithm is designed to reward businesses that provide valuable information and a positive user experience.

3.text: Verification typically involves receiving a postcard with a code or a phone call from Google.
A 2023 report indicated that businesses with verified profiles consistently outperform those that haven’t been verified.
A complete profile signals to Google that you’re serious about being found.
Fill out every section: Business Name: Use your official business name - don’t add extra words like “Inc.
” Address: Accurate and consistent with your signage.

4.text: Category: Choose the most relevant category for your business.
For example, instead of just “Restaurant,” choose “Italian Restaurant.
” Hours of Operation: Keep these updated, especially during holidays.
Accurate hours are vital for customer expectations.
Description: Write a compelling description of your business, incorporating relevant keywords.
This is your chance to tell your story and entice potential customers.
Now that your profile is complete, let’s focus on optimizing it for search.

5.text: Create posts about new products, special offers, or upcoming events.
For example, a bakery could post about a new seasonal pie or a holiday sale.
Aim for at least one post per month.
A recent study found that businesses with active posts receive 67 percent more views on their GBP listing
demonstrating the value of consistent engagement.
Upload high-quality photos and videos of your business, products, and services.

6.text: You can include a link to your GBP review page in your email signature, on your website
A 2024 study found that businesses with at least 50 reviews are more likely to appear on the first page of Google Maps
suggesting a critical mass is needed for optimal visibility.
Responding to reviews shows you care about your customers.

7.text: Acknowledge positive reviews and address negative reviews constructively.
Responding to reviews can improve your ranking and demonstrate engagement.
A prompt and thoughtful response can even turn a negative review into a positive experience.
Beyond your GBP profile, technical SEO factors play a role.
Google prioritizes mobile-friendly websites and GBP listings.
Ensure your website is responsive and loads quickly on mobile devices.
